title: 第174章 小叔，你回来了……
slug: 万一小叔对假千金是柏拉图呢
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“嗡——”的一声。

一阵刺耳的嗡鸣声从宋瓷耳中穿刺而过。

瞳孔剧烈收缩，宋瓷拿着手机的指骨都攥得发白。

为什么？

为什么孟晚会知道这些？

当初她为了制造与祝砚铮的“偶遇”，在翡世国际安排了人装作找她麻烦，这才引起了祝砚铮的注意。

那几个混混是宋瓷挑选很久找的，打钱的账户是她转个几个弯，打到那几个混混的私人账户上的。

全程不会有第三方插手，并且他们拿了钱就会离开京市，再不回来。

给他们转账的账户都是一次性的，转账之后就会立即销毁，应该不会这么轻易查到收款方才对。

而且，宋瓷发现，不仅是第一次见面时收买混混时的转账记录。

还有宋瓷独自去了商城，买了情药的转账记录。

宋瓷跟卖药的商家一直都是单线联系，甚至极少在线上交流，到底是怎么查到证据的？

宋瓷有些头晕。

眉头紧皱，宋瓷在脑海中飞速转了转，眼珠跟着动了动。

不，不可能。

即便孟晚真的知道了真相，这些证据也绝不可能是她这么轻易查出来的。

摆在她面前的证据内容都太详细太清晰了，好像一目了然，故意让她看懂一样。

指骨微顿，宋瓷深吸一口气，将那震耳欲聋的心跳声压了下去。

越到这个时候越要冷静。

终于收回了几分理智，宋瓷重新看向与孟晚的聊天界面。

似乎从订婚宴开始，事情就开始超出她的梦境与计划了。

孟晚确实会知道她自己的身份，但那也应该是在订婚宴以后了。

就好像梦境中那些不利于她的内容都被提前了一样。

宋瓷不太清楚，到底是哪里出了问题。

如果说梦境是预知的，那孟晚不应该这么早知道身份才对。

如果梦是可以改变的，那她至少，现在还不能认命。

手指重新停留在了聊天屏幕上，宋瓷编辑信息，重新发送。

【宋瓷】：又想用什么招数来诬陷我？

孟晚迅速回复。

【孟晚】：诬陷？宋瓷，证据确凿，你说这是诬陷？

【孟晚】：你做的那些脏事如果让小叔知道了，他绝不会轻易放过你。

【宋瓷】：你如果真的确定这些证据是真的，早就拿着这些证据去找祝砚铮告状了，还会在这里跟我谈条件？

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Buzz——" sound.

A harsh buzzing sound pierced through Song Ci's ears.

The pupils shrank violently, and Song Ci's finger bones holding the phone turned white.

Why?

Why does Meng Wan know this?

In order to create an "accidental encounter" with Zhu Yanzheng, she arranged for someone at Feishi International to pretend to cause trouble for her, which attracted Zhu Yanzheng's attention.

Song Ci had been looking for those gangsters for a long time, and she turned a few corners and transferred money to the personal accounts of those gangsters.

There will be no third party intervention in the whole process, and they will leave the city after taking the money and never come back.

The accounts used to transfer funds to them are all one-time use and will be destroyed immediately after the transfer. It should not be so easy to find the recipient.

Moreover, Song Ci discovered that it was not only the transfer records when he bribed the gangster when they first met.

There are also transfer records of Song Ci going to the mall alone and buying love potions.

Song Ci had always had one-way contact with the drug sellers, and rarely even communicated online. How did she find the evidence?

Song Ci was a little dizzy.

Frowning her brows, Song Ci quickly turned around in her mind, and her eyes moved accordingly.

No, not possible.

Even if Meng Wan really knew the truth, she would never be able to find out the evidence so easily.

The evidence before her was too detailed and clear, as if it was clear at a glance and deliberately meant for her to understand.

Her finger bones paused slightly, and Song Ci took a deep breath to suppress the deafening heartbeat.

At this time, you need to stay calm.

Finally regaining some sense, Song Ci looked at the chat interface with Meng Wan again.

It seems that starting from the engagement party, things began to go beyond her dreams and plans.

Meng Wan would indeed know her identity, but that should be after the engagement party.

It was as if the content in the dream that was not conducive to her had been brought forward.

Song Ci wasn't sure what went wrong.

If dreams are prophetic, then Meng Wan should not know his identity so early.

If dreams could be changed, then at least she couldn't accept her fate yet.

The finger stayed on the chat screen again, Song Ci edited the message and resent it.

[Song Ci]: What tricks do you want to use to frame me again?

Meng Wan replied quickly.

[Meng Wan]: Framed?Song Ci, the evidence is conclusive, do you think this is a false accusation?

[Meng Wan]: If my uncle finds out about the dirty things you did, he will never let you go easily.

[Song Ci]: If you were really sure that these evidences were true, you would have taken them to Zhu Yanzheng to file a complaint. Are you still here to negotiate terms with me?
